blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Sen. Joel Villanueva has recalled how he, his family and religious community suffered — and overcame — emotional distress amid “severe accusations and allegations” and political attacks apparently linking him to the flood control scandal over the past year. “Last year, I was also standing here, being criticized, being pelted with huge mud and heavy allegations and accusations. The mafia and forces of darkness joined forces to bring me down and trample on my dignity,” he said during the 48th anniversary celebration of the Jesus Is Lord (JIL) in Worldwide Church in Manila on Saturday.
